faqs.a:
It shall be unlawful for any person to:
(1)
Dump, deposit or dispose of any glass, paper, can, bottle, box, garbage or any other
                  trash whatsoever anywhere in any public park within the city, except in a trash receptacle
                  provided for such purpose.
(2)
Discharge or otherwise place in any pool, fountain, lake or stream within a public
                  park or recreation facility any substance, matter or thing which may result in pollution
                  of said waters.
(Code 1960, § 17-25; Code 1981, § 22-11)
